question: What is SCF Neural Quorum Governance, and who can vote?

golden.answer: Neural Quorum Governance (NQG) is SCF's reputation- and delegation-based voting system, not XLM voting or the Stellar Consensus Protocol. Verified Members have four tiers: Verified (view discussions only), Pathfinder (can delegate), Navigator (votes actively on Build Open projects) and Pilot (also a quarterly delegate and governance proposer). Community project voting applies to the Open Track only. Tier status is governance reputation, separate from award history and payout KYC/KYB.
keyFacts: NQG is reputation and delegation governance, not XLM voting or SCP.
Verified members only view; Pathfinders can delegate; Navigators vote on Open projects.
Pilots can also serve as quarterly delegates and propose governance changes.
Community project voting applies only to Build Open Track projects.
avoid: Do NOT say every basic Verified member votes actively or can be a delegate.
Do NOT extend Build Open voting to Integration, RFP or Public Goods.
golden.notes: Public Goods has a separate process; do not require or state its electorate.
